text:
alex_sales: Hey team — we have an incoming POC with Acme Logistics starting Monday. They want to simulate peak traffic ~500 qps sustained for 2 hours/day for 3 days. Can we get a temporary hosted throughput bump and scoped API key? Need to validate latency under real load. cc @maria_se @nina_sre

maria_se: Short answer: yes, can do temporary quota increase on Hosted with approvals. Need customer org id, intended duration, and whether any sensitive data will be sent. Also do they need scoped key tied to IP? :thinking:

alex_sales: Org: acme-logistics, poc contact: laura@acme.com. Duration: Mon-Wed next week, 2 hours/day 9-11am PT. Data: mostly product descriptions, no PII. IP lock preferred but not required. Also requested a non-prod key for their load test infra.

ben_support: I can generate a scoped key for them. Will the key live in customer infra or ours? If customer, recommend IP/CIDR restriction. If hosted testing from their cloud, we can allow specific CIDRs.

nina_sre: Two quick things — 1) need to ensure KV cache won't blow OOM under that QPS with long seq lengths; what model & seq len distribution? 2) we should set up a fallback policy: if we hit capacity, route to a cheaper model variant or enforce token throttling.

alex_sales: They're testing with 'redwood/gpt-medium' at ~1k token windows, mostly prompt+short responses. Will share sample load script. They asked about non-throttled burst for the 2-hour window.

infra-bot: [policy-check] Temporary quota increase requests require: SLA owner sign-off, security check, and SOC review if >24 hours. This request = 6 hours total => SOC not triggered. Please attach the PO number or AE approval.

maria_se: Got it. @alex_sales please paste the AE approval text here so I can attach. I'll start the internal ticket for a hosted QPS bump to 600 qps for the windows. We'll set hard limit at 650 qps and soft limit 600 with alerting.

alex_sales: AE approval: "I approve temporary hosted throughput increase for Acme POC 3/22-3/24 9-11PT to validate performance. AE: Benji R."

ben_support: Added IP restriction option. If they need a non-IP key, we should add short TTL and rotate after the POC. Example curl test:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-medium","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

nina_sre: I will schedule a canary ramp up and monitor GPU queue length and mem. If queue > 80% for 5m we'll trigger scaledown or fallback. Also enable detailed traces for those windows.

alex_sales: Thanks all. Can we confirm SLA/alerts and that the key will be scoped and TTL set to 48h post-POC? Also who will be oncall during windows?

maria_se: I'll be the SLA owner. @nina_sre oncall for infra. ben_support will handle key ops. I'll update the ticket and set alerts to slack channel #eng-oncall and email laura@acme.com for incident notices.

ben_support: :thumbsup: I'll create the scoped key and post the secure link to their SSO-integrated vault. Key TTL = 72h from creation unless you want 48h.

alex_sales: 48h TTL please. Last: any expected billing/overage concerns? Customer needs estimate for the 3-day run.

maria_se: I'll run the cost calc: estimate = tokens * rate with temporary bump; will DM numbers. For POC we'll provide one-time complimentary buffer up to $500 in token credits, per sales policy.

infra-bot: [ticket-created] Hosted throughput bump created: INC-2026. Config: 600 soft / 650 hard qps, TTL-scoped key pending. Monitored metrics: gpu_queue, latency_p50/p95, token_cost. Assigned: maria_se, ben_support, nina_sre.

alex_sales: Perfect. I'll loop in Acme and schedule the load tests. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
